contract: Unmodified pinned baseline/candidate harness and native fixtures verified by exact Git blob IDs; same installed assets and original 12s/4s deadlines.
Fresh per-sample subreaper, verified SET/GET, default SIGCHLD, sole Popen waiter followed by waitpid-to-ECHILD. No added PID/mount namespace or source admission.

Actual adopted direct children only, waitid WNOWAIT ownership check before SIGKILL, sole waiter prevents child-PID reuse until reap. Any forced cleanup stops subsequent samples and cannot mint native success.
Exact supervisor exit0/exit1/detached-setsid-orphan controls required before native samples.
Profile-defer metrics are diagnostic only; descendant absence is independent no-overlap evidence, not original runtime cleanup success.
Output drain bounded, overflow preserved as failure, full-stream digest only after EOF; incomplete output fails.
Independent regular-file/16MiB/80-file upload guard, fixed status-only refusal fallback; no native binaries/private configuration archived.

validation: Independent source inspection including unchanged original Run defer and peer cleanup paths.
git diff --check passed; author reports bash -n and embedded Python AST checks passed.

limitations: Linux supervisor controls and actual ABBA samples remain unexecuted until CI.
